C1.worst_defect: Four equal-weight buttons ('Live demo', 'Quick start', 'Try with your store', 'GitHub') under a hero that says the till 'signs in to your own Vendure store' and 'the quick start sets it up' leave a non-developer owner unsure whether 'Try with your store' works without their freelancer.

C2.worst_defect: Refunds at the till depend on 'the plugin release after 0.3.0, which is not out yet', repeated on home, At the till, Limitations and Connect a till with no date, so an owner cannot tell when till refunds arrive or whether to plan on settling refunds by hand in the Vendure Dashboard.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 table row 'Refund a sale at the till'; at-the-till 'Refund a sale'; limitations

C3.worst_defect: The path to staff selling runs through developer steps (Quick start step 3 migration scripts, step 6 tax strategies), and giving each cashier their own account, including adding the ReadOrder permission by hand 'until the next release', is not in the quick start but on Connect a till.
C3.where: quick-start steps 3-9; connect-a-till 'Give each cashier their own account'

C4.worst_defect: At the till, the page staff will use, never says what happens when the internet drops: no offline section, nothing on the 'orders waiting to send' header line, nothing on customer search and adding a customer failing offline. That is only in Troubleshooting 'Sell while offline'.
C4.where: at-the-till (all slices) vs troubleshooting 'Sell while offline'

C5.worst_defect: The payment screenshot shows a test product named 'Tally Fixture Mug', and its interface text is too small to read at desktop width.

C6.worst_defect: The cashier-sheet image on At the till renders as an empty bordered box on the phone, while the same image shows correctly on desktop.

C7.worst_defect: The 404 page logs a console error for a missing resource and carries no structured data; otherwise every page is 200, no overflow, all images have alt, Lighthouse 98/100/100/100, CLS 0, llms.txt, sitemap and search all respond.

overall_worst.defect: At the till, the cashier page, says nothing about selling when the internet drops: no word that sales keep working and send later, what the 'N orders waiting to send' header line means, or that customer search and adding a customer need a connection. A shop owner reading it cannot answer 'what happens when the internet drops' without finding Troubleshooting.
overall_worst.where: at-the-till (all slices); covered only in troubleshooting 'Sell while offline'
overall_worst.fix: Add a short 'If the internet drops' section to At the till: sales, discounts, parking and receipts keep working and send by themselves when the connection returns; the header shows how many orders are waiting; customer search and adding a customer need a connection; link to Troubleshooting 'Sell while offline'.
